title: 1ai-Skill
description: JSON Schema for 1ai-skills skill metadata. Validates both SKILL.md YAML frontmatter and SKILLS.json registry entries. All non-required fields have defaults in the validator so existing skills pass without modification.

semver.description: Semantic version. Accepts MAJOR.MINOR (existing skills) or full MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (recommended for new skills).

risk_level.description: Maximum potential risk if skill is misapplied. Info=read-only reference. Critical=financial transactions, irreversible actions.

schema_version.description: Version of the schema contract this metadata conforms to.

name.description: Unique kebab-case identifier. MUST match the directory name and SKILLS.json entry.

version.description: Skill version per semver. 0.1.0 for unversioned/initial skills.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Active=ready for use. Deprecated=still available but superseded. Removed=registry reference only, no file on disk.

subcategory.description: Optional subcategory within the parent category. Maps to subdirectory when applicable.

description.description: One-paragraph description. MUST include 'Use when' trigger phrase (enforced by linter).

domain.description: Domain area. Typically matches category. Broader groupings allowed.

tags.description: Discovery tags. First tag SHOULD be the primary domain.

triggers.description: Explicit trigger phrases. When an agent sees these inputs, it SHOULD activate this skill.

non_triggers.description: Situations where this skill MUST NOT activate, even on trigger match.

type.description: Expected type: string, number, boolean, object, array, file, url

inputs.description: Structured inputs the skill expects from the caller.

dependencies.description: Other skills this skill depends on (imports, extends, or builds upon).

tool_requirements.description: Tools the agent must have available.

resource.description: Target: filesystem, network, database, credentials, etc.

action.description: Action: read, write, execute, delete, modify

permissions.description: Explicit permission declarations. High/critical risk skills MUST document all permissions.

human_approval.description: True = requires explicit human approval before executing. Mandatory for high/critical risk skills.

supported_agents.description: Agent platforms this skill has been tested on.

author.description: Original author (GitHub handle or name). Empty = auto-generated.

last_reviewed.description: ISO 8601 date of last review for accuracy and safety.

owners.description: Responsible maintainers (GitHub handles or team names).

evaluation_profile.description: Populated by the evaluation system (Phase 7). Quality score per the Quality Rubric.

allOf.description: High and critical risk skills MUST require human approval.
